AccessKind.description:
How a source is read, derived from its URL's scheme and nothing else.

HTTPS may carry a token; SSH and the scp form are a deploy key; a `file://`
address or a bare absolute path is this box's own mount, and carries no
secret at all. An address naming none of them is refused rather than stored
as a fourth kind.
AccessKind.title: AccessKind

AccessRenewal.description: The new HTTPS token, or null for an SSH source, which renews its own pair.
AccessRenewal.title: AccessRenewal

AccountView.description:
One person's own theme, read and written.

No default: one schema serves the body and the answer.
AccountView.title: AccountView

AddressAccessView.description: The access the address names, or null when it names none.
AddressAccessView.title: AddressAccessView

AttemptView.description: The build that ran last while it did not become the talk.
AttemptView.title: AttemptView

BuildFailureReason.description:
Why a build produced nothing; the codes a page words in its own language.

The server refusals are named as the build-worker probe names its cases.
BuildFailureReason.title: BuildFailureReason

BuildOutcome.description: How the build a deck last started ended, while it is not its talk yet.
BuildOutcome.title: BuildOutcome

ConnectionCheckView.description: What a probe found; `detail` is git's own first line, not presentator's.
ConnectionCheckView.title: ConnectionCheckView

CreatedSourceView.description: The new source and the webhook secret, which no other answer carries.
CreatedSourceView.title: CreatedSourceView

DeckListView.description: The reader's decks, newest change first, and where an empty list points.
DeckListView.title: DeckListView

DeckState.description:
What the list and the deck page say a deck is, in one word.

It is read off the talk that stands and the attempt beside it, never
stored: two records that can each be written on their own would otherwise
disagree about one deck.
DeckState.title: DeckState

DeckSummary.description: One of the reader's decks: what it is, how it stands and when it changed.
DeckSummary.title: DeckSummary

DeckTextView.description: The words of a deck at its built commit.
DeckTextView.title: DeckTextView

DeckView.description: What a deck page says about one deck, as data.
DeckView.title: DeckView

FailureView.description:
Why a build failed: a code and its counts, and the toolchain's own words.

The text is set only for the `toolchain` reason; no sentence of this
server's is on the wire, the page words each reason itself.
FailureView.title: FailureView

KeyDraftView.description: An admin's draft deploy key: the id to bind and the half to install.
KeyDraftView.title: KeyDraftView

NewSource.description: A checked source to store: the probe, its name and the check's fingerprint.
NewSource.title: NewSource

Role.description: An instance has only these two roles.
Role.title: Role

SessionAddresses.description: Where a page sends a person to sign in or out, or to the central account.
SessionAddresses.title: SessionAddresses

SessionPerson.description: The signed-in person as the page shows them.
SessionPerson.title: SessionPerson

SessionView.description: Everything a page needs to know about the reader before it renders.
SessionView.title: SessionView

SettingsView.description: The instance settings and the languages an admin may choose from.
SettingsView.title: SettingsView

SettingsWrite.description: The instance name and language an admin sets for everyone.
SettingsWrite.title: SettingsWrite

SlideTextView.description: One slide's words: its number, title, body and speaker notes.
SlideTextView.title: SlideTextView

SourceAddress.description: An address as typed, before anything decides what it needs.
SourceAddress.title: SourceAddress

SourceFetchView.description: What a fetch changed; no run means another refresh held the lock.
SourceFetchView.title: SourceFetchView

SourceListView.description: Every source of the instance, in the owner's order.
SourceListView.title: SourceListView

SourceProbe.description: The address and credential of a source that is not stored yet.
SourceProbe.title: SourceProbe

SourceRemovalPreview.description: What removing a source takes with it: its decks and the runs it keeps.
SourceRemovalPreview.title: SourceRemovalPreview

SourceRunFailure.description:
Why a poll failed, in this product's own words rather than gitmirror's.

A separate enum from `gitmirror.model.ConnectionState` keeps that
package's exact wording from reaching a board by accident; the adapter,
which already speaks both vocabularies, owns the translation between them.
SourceRunFailure.title: SourceRunFailure

SourceRunOutcome.description:
Whether a poll of a source found its newest commit or could not.

Closed to these two. The third word a board may show — "never fetched" —
is not a value here: a source nobody has polled yet has no run at all, so
that case is told apart by the absence of a `SourceRun`, not by a member
of this enum.
SourceRunOutcome.title: SourceRunOutcome

SourceRunView.description: One poll of a source: when, how it ended and why it did not succeed.
SourceRunView.title: SourceRunView

SourceState.description:
What the sources list says a source is, read off its newest run.

No run is never-fetched and a successful run is reachable. A host that
never answers and a credential the instance could not resolve share one
word, error; the run's reason tells them apart. A refused login and a host
that answered with something else keep their own words.
SourceState.title: SourceState

SourceSummary.description: One source of the list: where it is, how it stands and when it was fetched.
SourceSummary.title: SourceSummary

SourceView.description: One source with its newest runs and the viewer's own decks from it.
SourceView.title: SourceView

ThemeChoice.description: The three looks a person can choose: follow the system, light or dark.
ThemeChoice.title: ThemeChoice

WebhookSecretView.description: The renewed webhook secret, which no other answer carries.
WebhookSecretView.title: WebhookSecretView
